name: Herbert Dorfmann - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the draft Council directive on Faster and Safer Relief of Excess Withholding Taxes
part_text:
Parliament approves the Council's draft law on relieving excess withholding taxes — the tax charged on dividends and interest paid to people in another EU country. The law introduces a common EU digital certificate of tax residence and two fast-track procedures alongside the existing standard refund. Compared with the Commission's original plan, deadlines are longer, small member states with relief-at-source systems are exempt, financial intermediaries must register, and the start date moves from 2027 to 2030. Parliament asks to be told if the Council departs from the approved text.

- **What changes:** A common EU digital tax residence certificate and faster refund routes, with the start date moved to 2030.
- **Who it affects:** Cross-border investors, national tax authorities and financial intermediaries, who must register.
- **What happens next:** The Council adopts the law; Parliament must be consulted again if the text changes substantially.
